IMPORTANT RESERVATION INFORMATION:

- GENERAL RESERVATIONS: Reservations for 1-8 guests are available 28 days in advance starting at 10:00 a.m.

- LIMITED SEATINGS: All tables are reserved for a scheduled amount of time: 1.75 hours for parties of 2 guests, 2 hours for parties of 3-5 guests and up to 2.5 hours for parties of 6-8 guests. Please arrive on time with your completed party. If you're running late by more than 10 minutes, please notify us and be aware that your dining time may be shortened in order to accommodate the next scheduled reservation.

- COURTYARD RESERVATIONS: Courtyard seating is open-air and weather permitting. We recommend dressing in layers as San Francisco weather varies and heating coverage is limited.

- STRICT CANCELLATION POLICY:  We require 24 hours notice for free cancellations. Cancellations and re-bookings within 24 hours are subject to a cancellation/no-show fee of $50/person. 

- LARGE PARTIES: Groups of 6-8 adults are required to order our nightly set menu @ $90/person. Larger parties of 9+ adults are required to make a reservation through our events page and participate in a banquet menu (izakayarintaro.com/events). Parties must be complete in order to be seated.

- ALLERGIES: If there are any strict allergies or dietary restrictions in your party, please notify us in case we need to make special accommodations.

- SERVICE FEE: Parties of 6+ are subject to a 20% service charge in lieu of gratuity.

If you have any questions or need to reach a member of our team, please email info@izakayarintaro.com or call (415) 589-7022. If your call is not answered, please be sure to leave a voice message.

Rintaro is a Japanese izakaya with modern, Northern California sensibilities. The interior, which is outfitted in hinoki cedar and redwood, is reminiscent of a shrine and the food is simple traditional fare, with an emphasis on ingredients and technique. Here's proof: konbu-cured Marin coast halibut sashimi with Half Moon Bay wasabi and handmade udon made daily.

- Though the Wine Bar is available for walk-ins on a first come, first served basis, reservations are highly encouraged.

If you have a moment beforehand, think about wines, regions or other topics you might like to discuss, and perhaps a few of your favorite wines. Flatiron Wines is for the curious. For adventurers and explorers. For anyone who loves wine or small-batch spirits, and wants to learn and taste more.

Our private Cellar Room event space is perfect for intimate gatherings, corporate events, and wine-focused celebrations.

Browse our retail selection of thousands of artisanal wines—from everyday values to rare finds, natural and organic selections, and small-batch spirits. Available for pickup or delivery throughout the Bay Area.
Our bar is open whenever we are, featuring a rotating by-the-glass menu. We also offer public tastings several times a week.
